anomaly_note: anomaly_score is copied from the detector catalogue. RomanRecoverer does not interpret it as a discovery.

confidence_intervals.assumptions: Eligible injections are treated as independent Bernoulli trials. Blending, crowded photometry, and a shared detection threshold violate that assumption, so these intervals are binomial uncertainties rather than a full survey covariance. The Wilson interval is the one to quote. The percentile bootstrap resamples the observed recoveries with replacement and can collapse when every trial has the same outcome.

eligibility.definition: An injection is eligible when it is unmasked and, if an image shape is known, its center lies in the closed interval [margin, n-1-margin] on both axes after converting to 0-based pixels. x is the column and y is the row.

false_positive_policy: Unmatched detections are not called false positives unless the dataset assumption is truth_complete_synthetic, or a baseline catalogue has been subtracted. A populated image can contain real sources that were never injected.

matching.tie_break: earlier detection row, then earlier eligible truth row

mode_note: Catalogue-only benchmark. No image was simulated by RomanRecoverer in this step, and no Roman instrument calibration was applied.

photometry.note: Photometric recovery bias is reported only when the injected and measured values are calibrated and in the same unit and quantity. A Gaussian peak amplitude is not an AB magnitude and is not a physical flux.
photometry.reason: calibration_status is 'uncalibrated_amplitude', not 'calibrated'. Refusing to treat uncalibrated amplitudes as fluxes or magnitudes.

position.definition: dx = x_detection - x_truth, dy = y_detection - y_truth, in the frame used for matching.

precision.policy: Unmatched detections are not called false positives unless the dataset assumption is truth_complete_synthetic, or a baseline catalogue has been subtracted. A populated image can contain real sources that were never injected.
precision.reason: Unmatched detections in a nonempty or unspecified background are not automatically false positives. They may be legitimate pre-existing sources. Pass --assumption truth_complete_synthetic only for a scene that contains no astrophysical sources besides the injections, or pass --baseline.

strata_notes.brightness: Brightness bins use the amplitude column as a brightness proxy. For NGRST-style tables this is a Gaussian peak, not a magnitude.
strata_notes.crowd_definition: Number of other eligible injected sources within crowd_radius of the source center, in the match frame.
strata_notes.local_background: No local_background column on the truth table. A background map is not invented during a catalogue-only run. Supply the column or an image to the synthetic path, which can record an annulus median.
strata_notes.magnitude: Magnitude bins are omitted because calibration_status is not 'calibrated' or no magnitude column is present. Physical magnitude bins are not invented from peak amplitudes.

snr.reason: Completeness is not stratified by detected SNR, because that quantity is undefined for unrecovered injections. Pass a truth SNR column to bin on an injected SNR.

threshold_policy: RomanRecoverer did not select a detection threshold. If a threshold was tuned on this same sample, the numbers are descriptive and are not an unbiased evaluation of that choice.
